text: AI coding agents can work without you watching.
So why are we still tied to a desk?
Picture this. In T3 Code, I start three agents.
One builds, one tests, and one reviews.
With Even G2, I'd see which agent needs me,
right in my field of view.
A tap on the R1 ring could select “Run final checks.”
The agent takes it from there.
No laptop. No phone. Just the update I need,
The rest of the day is mine.
Your agents keep working. Your world keeps moving.
That's the experience I want to build for Even Realities.
